tha-ap272:1.1: Taraṇiya.] Suvaṇṇavaṇṇo sambuddho Vipassī dakkhiṇāraho / nadītīre ṭhito satthā bhikkhusaṅghapurakkhato. // //
tha-ap272:2.1: Nāvā na vijjate tattha santāraṇī mahaṇṇave / nadiyā abhinikkhamma tāresiṃ lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap272:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ tāresiṃ naruttamaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi taraṇāya idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap272:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Taraṇiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap272:9.1: Ukkhepī Tela-Candī ca Dīpado ca Biḷālido Maccho Javo Salaḷado Rakkhaso Taraṇo dasa gāthāyo c' ettha saṅkhātā tālisam-ekam eva ca.
